data.question_title: The refractive index of a prism for a monochromatic wave is \(\sqrt{2} \) and its refracting angle is 60\(\mathrm{{}^\circ}\). For minimum deviation, the angle of incidence will be
data.explanation_txt:
For minimum deviation,

\(\mu = \cfrac{\sin \cfrac{A+\delta \, m}{2} }{\sin \cfrac{A}{2} }\)

But \(\cfrac{A+\delta _{m} }{2} =i\) \([A+\delta=i+e,\) for minimum deviation \(i=e]\)

\(\therefore \mu =\cfrac{\sin i}{\sin A/2} \)\(\Rightarrow \sqrt{2} =\cfrac{\sin i}{\sin \left(\cfrac{60}{2} \right)} \)

\(\Rightarrow \sqrt{2} \times \sin 30=\sin i\Rightarrow i=45^{o} \)

data.question_title: Dielectric constant for metal is
data.explanation_txt:
Dielectric constant \( K = \cfrac { \varepsilon } { \varepsilon _ { 0 } }\)

Dielectric constant, also called absolute permittivity, is the measure of the resistance that is encountered when forming an electric field in a medium. Metals have infinite permittivity as they completely negate the electric field inside their bulk. I.e. infinite resistance to setting up of field and hence infinite permittivity.

data.question_title: If the position vectors of the point A, B, C be i, j, k respectively and P be a point such that \(\vec { A B } = \vec { C P }\) then the position vector of P is
data.explanation_txt:
Let the position vector of P is \(x \mathbf { i } + y \mathbf { j } + z \mathbf { k }\) then

\( \vec { A B } = \vec { C P } \Rightarrow \mathbf { j } - \mathbf { i } = x \mathbf { i } + y \mathbf { j } + ( z - 1 ) \mathbf { k } \)

By comparing the coefficients of i, j and k we get

\(x = - 1 , \quad y = 1 \) and \( z - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow z = 1 \)

Hence required position vector is \(- \mathbf { i } + \mathbf { j } + \mathbf { k }\)
